invite.subject: You're invited to {{site}}
invite.heading: Welcome to {{site}}
invite.body: **{{inviter}}** has invited you to join {{site}} as {{role}}. Click the button below to activate your account.
invite.footer:
This invite link will expire in 7 days.

If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

verify_admin.subject: Verify Your Admin Account
verify_admin.heading: Welcome to {{site}} Admin
verify_admin.body: Thank you for registering as an admin user. Please verify your email address to complete your registration.
verify_admin.footer:
This verification link will expire in 24 hours.

If you didn't request this verification email, you can safely ignore it.

contact_form.subject: Contact Form: {{subject}}
contact_form.heading: New Contact Form Submission
contact_form.footer: This message was sent via the contact form on {{site}}.

order_confirmation.subject: We received your order: {{title}}
order_confirmation.heading: Order received
order_confirmation.body:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for your order. I will personally call you to confirm the details and walk through the deposit before anything is charged. Nothing has been charged yet.

**Estimate:** {{estimate}}

**Your order:**

```
{{summary}}
```

Please keep this email for your records.

subscription_confirmation.subject: Confirm Your Blog Subscription
subscription_confirmation.heading: Welcome to {{site}} Blog!
subscription_confirmation.body: Thank you for subscribing. Please confirm your email address to start receiving updates.
subscription_confirmation.footer:
This confirmation link will expire in 7 days.

If you didn't subscribe to this blog, you can safely ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your Password Has Been Changed
password_changed.heading: Password Changed
password_changed.body:
Your admin account password was recently changed {{change_source}}.

If you made this change, you can safely ignore this email.

**If you did not make this change**, please contact an administrator immediately as your account may have been compromised.
password_changed.footer: This is an automated security notification.

password_reset.subject: Password Reset Request
password_reset.heading: Password Reset Request
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your admin account password.
password_reset.footer:
**This link will expire in 1 hour.**

If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.
